description: This file provides utility functions for normalizing emails, domains, and usernames, as well as matching domains against watchlist entries, including wildcard support.

methods.name: normalizeEmail
methods.description: Normalizes an email address by trimming, converting to lowercase, and validating format.

methods.name: normalizeDomain
methods.description: Normalizes a domain by trimming, converting to lowercase, handling wildcards, and validating format.

methods.name: extractDomainFromEmail
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the domain part from an email address.

methods.name: normalizeUsername
methods.description: Normalizes a username by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: getWildcardPatternsForDomain
methods.description: Generates wildcard patterns for a domain to match subdomains.

methods.name: domainMatchesWatchlistEntry
methods.description: Checks if a domain matches a watchlist entry, supporting wildcards.
